name: 32303 · Tallahassee, FL
findings: ZIP 32303 (Tallahassee) has 267 nonprofit organizations. 115 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 95 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32303 (Tallahassee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
